newsitem.title: FRANCE: French truckers to tie up Paris in tax protest.
newsitem.headline: French truckers to tie up Paris in tax protest.

text.p: French truckers said on Tuesday they hoped to tie Paris traffic in knots on Thursday in a protest over fuel taxes.

Six hundred to 1,000 lorry drivers would be blocking off key access roads into eastern Paris in order to press their demands for lower taxes on diesel fuel, announced the National Road Transport Federation (FNTR) and the National Union of Road Transporter Associations (UNOSTRA).
"There is going to be a terrifying mess," an FNTR spokesman said, announcing that the operation had been dubbed "At the sound of a lorry".

The two unions, which represent drivers at 16,500 of France's 35,000 road transport firms, argue that taxes on diesel fuel are lower for onumerous ther professions including taxi drivers, fishing boats, and farmers.
